headline: Analysis-Three weeks in, Iran war escalates beyond Trump's control
summary: Three weeks into the Iran war, global energy prices are surging, the US is isolated from allies, and more troops are preparing to deploy. Trump had promised the conflict would be a short excursion.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and conflict in the Middle East affects crude supply, shipping routes and global energy prices.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012
